subject: A distinctive, independently corroborated alignment can check reconstructed customer histories.
rationale: The source mechanism licenses checking temporal consistency through distinctive correspondence across anchored, overlapping records. Under the stated hypothetical conditions, this supports checking participating customer histories for timing inconsistencies and possible anomalies. It does not verify every event or establish an omission without corroboration. The proposal asserts neither that a qualifying alignment has occurred nor that any history has already been validated.
